training_seeds.note: seeds 0-2 (B0) and 0-3 (V1) come from round 5; seeds 3-5 (B0) and 4-5 (V1) are round 6, identical settings

preregistered.unit_of_analysis: training run; episodes are never pooled across runs for significance
preregistered.primary: V1 vs B0 on 6 vs 6 run-level success rates, exact two-sided permutation test (924 permutations), alpha = 0.05
preregistered.interval: difference in means with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval, 20000 resamples, seed 20261006
preregistered.decision: supported as an improvement iff p < 0.05 and mean difference > 0; otherwise not established
preregistered.also: seed-to-seed sd per arm and whether V1 reduces it
